targets.title: ✦INTRADAY TRADER✦ If you can't explain your losses, you don't have a strategy. You have a hobby 🔥
targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Trading strategy for beginners: why you must be able to explain every loss in intraday trading, and how a trading journal turns a hobby into a real strategy.
If you can't explain your losses, you don't have a strategy. You have a hobby. A real strategy has clear entry rules, a stop loss, a risk limit and a reason for every trade. When a trade fails, a serious trader can say exactly why: wrong setup, rule broken, or normal loss within the plan. This video is for every intraday trader who wants to move from random trading to a repeatable process.
